name: PORTAL Shared Reality
purpose: Synchronize one spatial game world across phones, tablets, headsets and presentation displays.

model.anchor: common physical-world origin negotiated or resolved per device
model.object: networked spatial entity with owner and version

modes.description: Multiple camera devices see and manipulate the same anchored virtual world from their own viewpoints.
A phone observes player movement while a TV or other display presents the game experience.
Camera-tracked players, handheld AR players and headset players participate in one session.

requirements: AirPlay/display presentation treated as output, not authority
examples: tabletop cooperative dungeon visible from every phone
virtual creature moving through one real room while every player sees the same creature position
phone camera tracks a standing player while spectators watch the composited game on TV
one player in VR interacts with objects that phone AR players see in the same shared world
